svg.text: all commands and CPU jobs; AXI
Verification: every link is checked bit for bit, from llama2.c to the board
Whole model (every step's token and logits)
Compiled without FMA contraction (-ffp-contract=off). The board's 256-step trace matches fw/build/golden line for line; any changed bit in any logit changes the hash.
Every result is compared bit for bit (no tolerances). The float units round to nearest even like the CPU and flush subnormals, a range these values never reach.
On the board, fw/build/bringup.elf checks the CPU, FPU, DDR3 and one engine matmul against the CPU; the whole-model trace above checks everything else.
